# 🧠 Architecture Decision Record

## Metadata
- ADR number:
- Title:
- Status: proposed / accepted / superseded / deprecated
- Date:
- Decision owner:

## Context
Describe the problem, constraints and forces.

## Decision
State the chosen approach precisely.

## Alternatives
List realistic options considered and why they were rejected.

## Consequences
Document positive, negative and operational consequences.

## Security and privacy
Describe trust boundaries, data impact and threat mitigations.

## Rollout and reversibility
Describe migration, compatibility, rollback and follow-up work.

## References
Link issues, pull requests and relevant docs.
